picked.t: Vietnamese woman quits $7,700-a-month job to open vegetarian restaurant
picked.body: Diep, 57, spends most of her time at the two Ho Chi Minh City branches of her restaurant, Shamballa. She oversees the kitchen, interacts with staff and customers, and develops vegetarian products for home cooking. The epiphany came in the summer of 2012 during her second trip to Tibet, when she suffered a severe health crisis. She experienced shortness of breath, facial swelling, and a squeezing sensation in her head. For nearly three weeks, she relied on oxygen masks and care from local monks and nuns, who provided intravenous drips and nourishment. "There were times I thought I wouldn't survive," she says. Before the trip, she had spent years working at large corporations. She was accustomed to long meetings, overseas business trips, and a senior management job that fetched her over VND200 million a month. She had a lifestyle many people would have given an arm and a leg for, but her days bedridden in Tibet made her truly understand human fragility and its limits against illness. "I suddenly realized that such a high salary means nothing in the face of death." Returning to Vietnam, she continued her office job, business trips, and familiar pace of life, but her perspective on life had changed irreversibly. She switched to a strict vegetarian diet and paid more attention to meditation and things that had previously been overshadowed by work. Research shows that a near-death experience can change how people view life, leading them to appreciate nature, care for others, and better understand the meaning of life. It can also change diets. A 2023 review study by Tani Khara of Australia's University of Technology Sydney claimed there were eight cases where individuals switched from eating meat to a vegetarian or plant-based diet following a near-death experience. During her early years as a vegetarian, Diep struggled to find meals that suited her palate. She liked noodle soups, but many vegetarian restaurants failed to meet her flavor expectations. As a result, she went into the kitchen and experimented with ingredients, looking for ways to make dishes that were both delicious and visually appealing. She wanted to make vegetarian foods good enough for carnivores not to sniff at. More than a month after starting her vegetarian diet, a staff member offered her a meat-filled fried spring roll at a company conference party in Hanoi. Diep accepted and took a bite. She immediately felt ashamed for breaking her commitment to herself. "If I could not overcome such a small temptation, how could I achieve great things?" she says about that episode. After that, she gave up meat completely. In 2015, during a three-week pilgrimage in India, she first told her meditation teacher about her desire to open a restaurant. But she did not want a place exclusively for vegetarians; she wanted the food to be tasty and beautiful enough to attract non-vegetarians as well. The teacher told her that if she wanted to do it, he would support her. The idea stayed in her mind for a few more years. She continued her corporate job but paid close attention to the food, preparation methods, ambiance, and diner experience whenever she ate out. One morning in 2018, she woke up and realized things had changed: "I suddenly woke up and didn't want to do office work for another minute. I just wanted to open a vegetarian restaurant." Her superiors did not want her to quit, suggesting she should take a few months of unpaid leave to think it over. The position would be hers if she wanted to return, they promised. But after those few months passed, she did not want to go back. This time, she chose the restaurant. Friends called her "crazy," while her family respected her choice. Later, the same friends who had questioned her decision helped her during the early days of her business. In May 2019, Diep opened her first vegetarian restaurant on Trinh Van Can Street in Ho Chi Minh City. She named it Shamballa, referring to a concept in Tibetan philosophy representing a realm of peace without suffering. The name was redolent of the trip that changed her perspective on life. She wanted the restaurant to be a place where diners could temporarily escape the outside pace of life and enjoy a meal in a quiet space. In the early days, business was good, with the restaurant attracting lots of foreign tourists. At times, people had to book tables in advance. She then opened a new, larger, and more convenient branch in the downtown area. But just seven months after the first restaurant opened, the Covid-19 pandemic broke out. Business plummeted, but the restaurant had to pay staff and for operating costs. Diep had to dip into her savings. "I almost emptied my savings, and even had to borrow from friends," she says. Colleagues and former bosses asked her to return to the office, but she refused. 기사 이해를 돕기위해 AI를 활용해 제작한 이미지입니다. 베트남 증시가 FTSE러셀의 세컨더리 이머징마켓 승격을 앞둔 가운데 세계 2위 자산운용사 뱅가드(Vanguard)가 베트남 증시에 25억 달러가 투자될 것임을 공개적으로 밝혔다. 이는 그동안 애널리스트들이 내놨던 전망치를 크게 웃도는 규모다. 던컨 번스(Duncan Burns) 뱅가드 아시아·태평양 투자·글로벌주식 부문 대표는 지난 18일 한 행사에서 이 같은 자금 유입 규모를 밝혔다. 번스 대표는 “FTSE러셀의 베트남 증시 공식 승격 이후 1년 이내 패시브 자금 25억 달러가 유입될 것으로 전망된다”고 설명했다. 그는 이어 “주요 벤치마크 지수에 편입된 시장은 통상적으로 인지도가 높아져 투자자 참여를 유도하고, 글로벌 자본에 대한 접근성을 강화할 수 있다”며 “많은 투자자들이 베트남을 한 번도 방문한 적이 없을 수 있지만, 우리를 통해 베트남 증시의 지속 가능에 참여할 수 있다”고 설명했다. 베트남 증시는 오는 21일 FTSE러셀 기준 세컨더리 이머징마켓으로 공식 편입된다. 이를 통해 베트남 증시는 글로벌 자본이 유입될 기회를 한층 넓히게 된다. 베트남 증권사 SSI증권의 분석에 따르면, FTSE글로벌에쿼티인덱스시리즈(FTSE Global Equity Index Series)를 추종하는 뱅가드 펀드들은 베트남 종목 27개에 걸쳐 약 2억4,050만 달러의 순매수에 나설 것으로 예상된다. FTSE가 지난 8월 말 발표한 최신 포트폴리오에서는 베트남 종목 27개가 이머징마켓 지수 바스켓에 새로 편입됐다. 시가총액 기준으로는 빈그룹(Vingroup)과 비엣콤은행(Vietcombank), 빈홈(Vinhomes) 등 3개 종목이 대형주 그룹으로 분류됐으며, 중형주 그룹에는 베트남투자개발은행(BIDV), 화팟그룹(Hoa Phat Group), VP은행(VPBank) 등이 추가됐다. 나머지 21개 종목은 소형주 그룹에 속한다. 이에 대해 베트남 재무부는 “규제 당국은 시장 지배구조의 질과 시장 규율을 계속 높여나갈 것”이라고 밝혔다. 재무부는 현대적 시장 발전 흐름에 맞춰 새로운 시장 모델과 상품을 위한 법적 토대를 마련할 방침이다. 정부는 이어 “투명하고 안전하며, 매력적인 자본 시장을 구축하기 위한 개혁을 지속할 것”이라며 “이러한 노력은 투자자, 특히 외국인 투자자를 위한 여건을 조성하고 국제기준에 맞춰 시장 접근성을 개선하는 것을 목표로 한다”고 밝혔다. 재무부는 현대적 시장 발전 흐름에 맞춰 새로운 시장 모델과 상품을 위한 법적 토대를 마련할 방침이다.

picked.t: ‘고금리 장기화’ 베트남, 개인예금 사상 최고치…7월 기준 4,300억 달러 돌파
picked.body: 기사 이해를 돕기위해 AI를 활용해 제작한 이미지입니다. 베트남의 가계예금이 또다시 사상 최고치를 경신했다. 이는 올 들어고금리 장기화로 인해 부동산이나 증시보다 예금이 매력적이고 안정적인 투자처로 부상한 데 따른 영향으로 풀이된다. 베트남중앙은행(SBV)의 최신 자료에 따르면, 7월 말 기준 베트남 은행권에 예치된 가계 예금잔액은 전월 대비 약 151조9,000억 동(약 58억4,300만 달러, 1.37%) 증가한 1경1,220조 동(4,315억8,850만여 달러)을 기록했다. 올 들어 가계예금은 885조1,000억 동(약 340억4,630만 달러) 증가했는데, 지난해 말과 비교하면 8.56% 증가한 수준이다. 고금리 장기화로 인해 작년 8월 7,800조 동(3,000억3,480만 달러)이던 가계 예금잔액은 무려 3,400조 동(약 1,310억 달러) 이상 급증했다. 이를 두고 한 금융 전문가는 “6개월 이상 만기 상품의 예금금리가 9% 안팎에 이르는 점은 여윳돈을 보유한 가계에는 상당히 매력적인 부분”이라며 “경제 불확실성 속 정기예금은 안전하면서도 수익성 있는 선택지”라고 설명했다. 금융 업계는 자본 수요가 계속 증가함에 따라 연말까지 예금금리가 높은 수준을 유지할 것으로 전망했다. 같은 기간 기업예금은 6,240조 동(2,400억2,780만여 달러)으로 전년말 대비 0.98% 증가했다. 전월과 비교하면 약 130조7,000억 동(50억2,750만여 달러, 2%) 이상 감소한 수준이다. 이러한 가계예금 급증세의 배경으로는 큰 폭으로 치솟은 예금금리가 꼽힌다. 재무부에 따르면 ,7월 말 기준 12개월 만기 정기예금의 실질 금리는 연 8.8~9.5%로 은행권의 공시 금리보다 높게 나타났다. 대출금리도 상승세를 보였는데, 8월 20일 기준 신규 대출의 평균 금리는 연 8.93% 수준으로, 전년말 대비 0.85%포인트 상승했다. 이 중 주택담보대출이나 기타 부동산 대출금리는 대체로 연 10~12% 수준을 유지했는데, 일부는 14~15%에 달하기도 했다. 한편, 늘어난 수신 만큼이나 여신 증가세도 가속화되는 모습이 확인됐다. 베트남중앙은행에 따르면 8월 28일 기준 은행권 대출잔액은 약 2경500조 동(7,885억5,300만 달러)으로 전년말 대비 10.24% 증가했다. 여신 증가율이 수신 증가율(8.56%)을 또다시 앞지른 셈이다.

picked.t: 10 best fine dining restaurants in Southeast Asia
picked.body: Koma Singapore topped the list for the second consecutive year in Tripadvisor's 2026 Travelers' Choice Best of the Best Restaurants Awards, based on an analysis of reviews from the travel platform's users. The restaurant at Marina Bay Sands serves modern Japanese cuisine, combining ingredients sourced from Japan with contemporary influences. Guests enter through a 20-meter passageway lined with glowing vermillion arches inspired by Kyoto's Fushimi Inari Shrine before arriving at an atmospheric bar. The Rhythms Restaurant in Hanoi ranked second. Located on the seventh floor of La Sinfonía del Rey Hotel & Spa in downtown Hanoi, it has an outdoor dining area overlooking Hoan Kiem Lake and the Old Quarter. The restaurant serves fine-dining dishes, cocktails and wine. Its west-facing terrace also offers views of the sunset over the city. Kroya by Chef Chanrith , at Shinta Mani Angkor in Cambodia's Siem Reap, ranked third. It serves modern Cambodian cuisine inspired by traditional Khmer recipes. The restaurant uses local ingredients and contemporary cooking techniques. Its lunch menu features à la carte dishes, while dinner is offered as a set menu highlighting seasonal flavors. Diners can choose between the indoor dining area and open-air swing tables. The restaurant is open to both hotel guests and outside visitors. Boy'N'Cow on the popular tourist island Bali in Indonesia, a dry-aged meat restaurant and cocktail lounge specializing in beef aged on site, secured the fourth place. The restaurant uses ingredients sourced from different countries and prepares its dishes from scratch, Tripadvisor wrote. Its menu features share-style dishes alongside handcrafted cocktails, served in an industrial-style setting with an upbeat atmosphere. Dava , an Argentine-inspired restaurant with panoramic ocean views beside the AYANA Villas Lobby in Indonesia, ranked fifth. The restaurant focuses on Argentina's asado barbecue tradition, serving beef cuts and line-caught seafood cooked over a wood-fired grill. Its menu includes Wagyu steaks, Latin-inspired dishes and seafood preparations. It also offers South American-inspired cocktails, a selection of wines and house-made desserts. Diners can choose between the open-air setting and ocean views, particularly around sunset. At sixth position, Henshin is a Peruvian-Japanese restaurant and rooftop bar on levels 67-69 of The Westin Jakarta, making it one of the city's highest dining venues. The restaurant specializes in Nikkei cuisine, combining Japanese and Peruvian culinary influences under the direction of a Peruvian chef. Its dining areas and rooftop bar offer panoramic views of Jakarta's skyline. Bai Yun , a Chinese hot-pot restaurant in Nusa Dua, Indonesia, ranked seventh. Its name means "white cloud" in Mandarin, referring to the steam rising from the hot pot, which resembles clouds. The restaurant offers a selection of fresh ingredients and sauce combinations. Benjarong , included in the 2026 Michelin Guide for the Philippines, came in 8th. It serves traditional Thai cuisine with a modern approach, combining time-honored cooking techniques with contemporary presentation. Summer Palace at Edsa Shangri-La of the Philippines ranked 9th. Located on the mezzanine level of the Tower Wing in Luzon, the restaurant serves Cantonese cuisine, with a menu of around 180 dishes featuring dim sum, seafood and noodles. It offers eight signature dishes and classics created by its culinary team. Smoking is not permitted. Finishing the top 10 were Thailand's Punjab Grill Bangkok which serves Indian cuisine with a focus on dishes from India's northwestern region, combining traditional recipes with contemporary interpretations. Led by Chef Bharath S. Bhat, the restaurant's menu includes vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes, along with specialties such as crab and lentil shorba, avocado papdi chaat, tawa scallops and tandoori jheenga, Tripadvisor describes. Classic dishes include butter chicken, dal makhani and lamb rogan josh. Photos courtesy of the restaurants and Tripadvisor

picked.t: 벤가드, 베트남 증시에 25억달러 투자...FTSE 러셀 승격에 글로벌 자금 유입 본격화
picked.body: 베트남 국가증권위원회 관계자들과 글로벌 자산운용사 벤가드 관계자들이 하노이에서 열린 베트남 증시 시장 승격 관련 행사에서 기념촬영을 하고 있다. / 베트남 국가증권위원회 (호치민=베트남코리아타임즈) 홍 리 (Hong Ly) 기자 = 세계 2위 자산운용사인 미국 벤가드(Vanguard)가 베트남 주식시장에 약 25억달러(약 3조4700억원)를 투자할 계획이다. 베트남 증시가 글로벌 지수 제공업체 FTSE 러셀(FTSE Russell)의 신흥시장으로 공식 승격되면서 글로벌 대형 자산운용사의 베트남 시장 투자가 본격화되는 모습이다. 벤가드의 아시아·태평양 지역 투자관리 및 글로벌 주식 부문 책임자인 던컨 번스(Duncan Burns)는 지난 18일 하노이에서 열린 베트남 증시의 FTSE 러셀 시장 승격 관련 행사에서 향후 베트남 주식에 약 25억달러를 투자할 계획이라고 밝혔다. 벤가드의 투자 규모는 앞서 베트남 증권업계에서 예상했던 10억~20억달러 수준을 웃도는 규모다.벤가드는 FTSE 러셀 지수를 추종하는 펀드를 중심으로 베트남 시장에 대한 투자를 확대할 계획이며, 벤가드 측은 시장이 주요 글로벌 지수에 편입될 경우 투자자들의 시장 접근성이 높아진다고 설명했다. 벤가드가 베트남 시장에 주목하게 된 핵심 배경에는 FTSE 러셀의 시장 분류 변경이 있다. 베트남 증시는 21일부터 FTSE 러셀 기준 프런티어 시장에서 '세컨더리 이머징 마켓(Secondary Emerging Market)'으로 공식 승격됐다. 베트남 주식이 글로벌 신흥시장 지수에 포함되면서 FTSE 러셀을 추종하는 글로벌 펀드들이 베트남 주식을 포트폴리오에 편입할 수 있는 기반이 마련됐다. FTSE 러셀의 베트남 시장 편입은 한 번에 완료되는 방식이 아니다. 오는 9월 첫 단계에서 투자 가능 비중의 10%가 반영되고, 2027년 3월 20%, 6월 35%, 9월 35%가 추가되는 방식으로 총 네 차례에 걸쳐 진행된다. 이에 따라 지수를 추종하는 패시브 자금 역시 단계적으로 베트남 주식에 유입될 전망이다. SSI리서치는 FTSE 러셀 지수를 추종하는 벤가드 펀드 등을 중심으로 첫 단계에서 약 2억4050만달러(약 3340억원)의 자금이 베트남 주식 27개 종목에 유입될 것으로 추산했다. 이는 벤가드가 향후 투자할 것으로 밝힌 25억달러와는 별개의 개념으로, FTSE 지수 편입에 따라 발생하는 초기 패시브 자금의 성격이 강하다. SSI가 지난 17일 공개한 분석에 따르면 향후 12개월 동안 FTSE 관련 ETF가 베트남 주식에 배분할 수 있는 자금은 약 22억1000만달러(약 3조600억원) 규모다. 이 가운데 상당 부분은 벤가드가 운용하는 펀드에서 나올 것으로 예상됐다. SSI는 벤가드 토털 인터내셔널 스톡 ETF(Vanguard Total International Stock ETF), 벤가드 FTSE 이머징마켓 ETF(Vanguard FTSE Emerging Markets ETF) 등 주요 펀드의 베트남 투자 비중을 바탕으로 자금 유입 규모를 추산했다. 벤가드 FTSE 이머징마켓 ETF의 경우 약 7억9500만달러가 베트남 주식에 배분될 수 있는 것으로 분석됐다. 다만 실제 베트남 증시로 들어오는 글로벌 자금은 패시브 투자에만 한정되지 않을 전망이다. 토마스 응우옌(Thomas Nguyen) SSI증권 글로벌시장 총괄은 최근 베트남 증시에 유입될 수 있는 자금 규모가 ETF 등 패시브 자금뿐 아니라 액티브 펀드까지 포함할 경우 더욱 커질 수 있다고 분석했다. 그는 향후 12개월 동안 베트남 증시에 유입될 수 있는 전체 외국인 자금이 약 100억달러(약 13조8700억원)에 이를 가능성도 제시했다. 다만 이는 확정된 투자금액이 아니라 시장 환경과 투자자의 자산 배분에 따라 달라질 수 있는 전망치다. FTSE 러셀 편입으로 직접적인 수혜가 예상되는 종목도 있다. SSI의 분석에서는 빈그룹(Vingroup, VIC), 빈홈스(Vinhomes, VHM), 호아팟그룹(Hoa Phat Group, HPG), VP은행(VPB), FPT 등이 상대적으로 많은 ETF 자금을 받을 가능성이 있는 종목으로 거론됐다. 특히 빈그룹은 약 6억9000만달러의 자금이 유입될 수 있는 것으로 추산돼 전체 예상 ETF 자금의 약 32%를 차지할 수 있는 것으로 분석됐다. 외국인 투자자들의 움직임에서도 변화가 나타나고 있다. 9월 14일부터 18일까지 외국인 투자자들은 호찌민증권거래소에서 2조7000억동(약 1040억원)을 순매수했다. 다만 올해 누적으로는 외국인이 약 91조동(약 3조5000억원)을 순매도한 상태여서 최근 매수세만으로 외국인 자금 흐름이 완전히 전환됐다고 판단하기는 이르다. 이번 FTSE 러셀 승격은 베트남 증시가 글로벌 투자자들의 포트폴리오에 본격적으로 편입되는 출발점이라는 의미도 갖는다. 로이터통신은 FTSE 러셀의 신흥시장 편입으로 베트남 증시에 최대 60억달러의 해외 자금이 유입될 수 있다고 전했다. 다만 실제 유입 규모는 각 지수를 추종하는 펀드의 운용자산 규모와 베트남 주식의 지수 편입 비중, 펀드별 투자 전략 등에 따라 달라질 수 있다. 베트남 증시가 앞으로 풀어야 할 과제도 남아 있다. 외국인 지분 한도와 일부 종목의 낮은 유통주식 비율 등은 여전히 글로벌 투자자들의 시장 접근을 제한하는 요인으로 꼽힌다. 또한 베트남이 향후 MSCI의 신흥시장 지위까지 확보하기 위해서는 중앙청산소(CCP) 도입 등 추가적인 시장 인프라 개선이 필요하다는 분석이 나온다. 벤가드의 25억달러 투자 계획은 이런 변화 속에서 글로벌 대형 자산운용사가 베트남을 장기적인 투자 대상으로 편입하고 있음을 보여주는 사례다. FTSE 러셀 편입이 단계적으로 진행되는 만큼 실제 자금 유입과 VN지수 및 주요 종목에 미치는 영향 역시 2027년까지 이어질 전망이다.   <저작권자(c) 베트남코리아타임즈, 무단 전재-재배포 금지>

picked.t: HCMC restaurant owner claims cop pockets $67,000 in prostitution protection scam
picked.body: Nguyen Dinh Thong, 53, said he paid former police officer Ha Manh Truong to shield illicit activities at his two restaurants on Tran Quang Khai Street in Tan Dinh Ward. Thong is set to stand trial at the Ho Chi Minh City People’s Court on Sept. 22 on charges of procuring prostitution and bribery. Truong, 43, is charged with "fraud" and "appropriation of property." Three other defendants who managed Thong's restaurants have also been charged with "procuring prostitution." According to the indictment, Thong appointed Dong Trong Le, 48, as general manager and Vo Phuc Chau, 36, as deputy general manager of the two facilities. Starting in February 2024, they allowed female hostesses to engage in prostitution. Once or twice a month, Thong and Le visited the facilities to instruct managers on operations, including arranging for hostesses to have sex with customers. The hostesses negotiated directly with customers, charging between VND2.5 million and VND3 million per encounter, and kept the entire amount. Managers received 20% of the room bills they booked, along with additional money from customers when they arranged the services. On the night of Nov. 7, 2024, HCMC police inspected two hotels in Phu Nhuan District and caught several hostesses from Thong's restaurants having sex with customers. Case records show that Thong profited the most from the illicit operations, earning VND125 million. Le received more than VND28 million, Chau collected over VND3.7 million, and two other female employees each received VND500,000. During the investigation, Thong said he met Truong through social connections. At the time, Truong was serving as an officer with Team 2 of the municipal Criminal Police Division. In February 2024, Thong asked Truong to contact leaders of the District 1 police and the Criminal Police Division to establish a monthly payoff system in exchange for preventing inspections. Thong subsequently made multiple payments to Truong totaling VND1.75 billion. Investigators determined that after receiving the money, Truong ignored Thong's request and instead used all the funds for personal expenses. Truong initially admitted to the conduct but later changed his testimony to deny appropriating the money. He claimed he initially accepted the funds because he feared refusing would affect his job, and that he later returned the money.

picked.t: Vietnam ranks among world's top 10 for real estate transparency improvements
picked.body: Overall, Vietnam ranked 50th among 88 countries and territories surveyed, with a transparency score of 3.15, remaining in the Semi-Transparent category of JLL's 2026 Global Real Estate Transparency Index. JLL's index assesses real estate transparency across six areas: market performance measurement, governance and regulation, market fundamentals, transaction processes, governance of listed companies and sustainability. The Asia-Pacific region recorded the strongest gains in transparency, hosting five of the 10 most improved markets: India, Vietnam, South Korea, Australia and Thailand. Others in the top 10 included Poland, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. JLL said the improvements had helped drive a recovery in cross-border investment in the region over the past 12 months, with direct investment transaction volumes in some markets, including Vietnam, reaching record levels. Before 2020, Vietnam was classified as a Low Transparency market, with limited market data and complex legal frameworks that created challenges for foreign property investors, according to JLL's data. A turning point came in 2016 when Vietnam joined the Trans-Pacific Partnership and proposed developing a national real estate database, signaling efforts to align the market with international standards. The country moved into the Semi-Transparent category in 2020. In 2024, Vietnam took a major step in strengthening its legal framework, as the revised laws on land, housing and real estate business came into effect. The revised Law on Price also introduced requirements for certified valuation professionals and verifiable audit trails for valuations, while regulations required real estate transactions to be conducted through the banking system. A new degree on the construction, management and operation of housing and real estate market information systems took effect this year, with the goal of completing the national land database by the end of 2026. The country has also seen greater adoption of sustainable development practices in the real estate sector. "The fact that Vietnam is ranked among the global top 10 markets with the strongest improvements in transparency is the result of a long and sustained process," said Le Thi Huyen Trang, JLL Vietnam's general director. Trang said reforms to the legal framework, administrative procedures and economic policy, have begun to produce positive results, reflected in rising registered foreign investment. She noted that Vietnam recorded US$38.1 billion in registered foreign investment in the first seven months of 2026, nearly matching the total registered FDI in the previous year and marking the highest level in a decade. JLL's report also highlighted a relationship between market transparency and the accuracy and efficiency of property valuations. In Semi-transparent markets such as Vietnam, fragmented and limited data mean valuation accuracy is estimated at around 70%, while the process can take up to 20 days. The accuracy is around 90% in Highly Transparent markets where transaction data is publicly available and comprehensive, with valuations typically taking five to 10 days. According to JLL, further progress towards greater transparency in Vietnam will depend on completing the digitization of land records, establishing a unified nationwide property registration system, applying international valuation standards and publishing data on commercial real estate credit markets. It also requires expanding green building certification, more comprehensive planning and reliable databases and stronger disclosure requirements for listed companies. JLL said greater transparency would become increasingly important for investors as economic and geopolitical uncertainty, artificial intelligence, shifting capital flows, energy security and changes in real estate credit markets reshape investment decision-making worldwide.

picked.t: Vietnam's largest island Phu Quoc races to finish light rail, airport expansion before APEC 2027
picked.body: At the heart of this transformation is DT975, the corridor connecting Phu Quoc International Airport with the APEC Convention Center. With a 62-meter cross-section featuring 10 motor vehicle lanes and an integrated light rail transit (LRT) line, the route is being developed as a key component of the island's future transport network. A notable feature of the project is the LRT line running along the central median, creating a combination of high-capacity road and urban rail transport. The design aims to facilitate seamless movement and reduce at-grade crossings. The LRT route will be adapted to the island's terrain, with 14.81 km running at ground level, 0.78 km on elevated structures and 2 km underground through the APEC core area. Six stations are planned along the route, with their designs drawing inspiration from the cultural identities of different parts of Vietnam, including the northwestern region, Hanoi's Old Quarter, the former imperial capital of Hue, the Central Highlands and Saigon, as well as an underground APEC station. DT975 will lead into APEC Boulevard, a roughly 3-km ceremonial route connecting to the APEC convention and exhibition complex and a multi-purpose theater. LED screens and large electronic displays will be installed along the median and at key intersections to present images of Vietnam and its people to international visitors. The transport corridor is also being designed with an emphasis on landscape and environmental integration. The central median will feature a continuous green corridor, including locally grown bougainvillea, creating a "green infrastructure" layer along the route. Construction is being accelerated to keep pace with preparations for APEC 2027. Despite rainy-season weather and complex geological conditions, construction teams are maintaining three shifts around the clock to stay on schedule. As of early September, around 65% of the technical trench work under the DT975 expansion project had been completed, while the longitudinal drainage system and road foundation works had reached nearly 50%. All four bridges along the route are under construction, with overall progress exceeding 55%. Asphalt concrete paving on both sides of the road is scheduled to be completed in stages from late 2026 to early 2027. Construction of the LRT is progressing in parallel. While civil works on tunnels, bridges and stations are underway, rail installation on the track bed has also begun. The entire 17.59-km double-track line is expected to have its rail system installed within the next six months, placing the project among Vietnam's urban railway developments with a rapid implementation schedule. Dr. Vo Tri Thanh, Director of the Institute for Brand and Competitiveness Strategy Research, said APEC 2027 represented a rare opportunity for Phu Quoc to make a qualitative breakthrough in infrastructure development and establish a new growth pole. According to a representative of Sun Group, the investor, DT975 forms part of a broader multimodal infrastructure network taking shape on Phu Quoc, linking air, water and land transport. The expansion of Phu Quoc International Airport is expected to serve as the island's air gateway, with the project also being accelerated for completion and operation in 2027. The group and An Giang province are also studying cooperation on more than 10 infrastructure and tourism projects, with the aim of developing Phu Quoc into an international tourism, trade and financial centre. Among them are An Thoi International Port and a 40-ha mixed-use tourism and port logistics urban area in Phu Quoc Special Zone, with total investment estimated at VND17 trillion (US$653 million). The projects are planned in conjunction with a coastal road connecting to An Thoi seaport. The combination of air transport, multi-lane roads, urban rail and seaport infrastructure is expected to strengthen Phu Quoc's transport capacity for APEC 2027 while establishing the foundations for an integrated transport network in the longer term. Beyond serving a major international event, the emerging multimodal network is expected to become an important part of Phu Quoc's future development capacity and competitiveness. The Phu Quoc Special Zone covers more than 570 sq.km and comprises 51 neighborhoods. Under the An Giang provincial People's Committee's master plan, the island, Vietnam's largest, is envisioned as a world-class eco-tourism hub and a venue for events, premium services, and healthcare.

picked.t: Ho Chi Minh City jumps 81 places in global cities ranking
picked.body: The city scored 62.6 points in the 2026 Global Cities Index, which assesses the strengths, weaknesses and future potential of the world's 1,000 largest cities. The index is compiled by Oxford Economics, a major independent economic research and consulting organization based in the U.K. The index evaluates cities across five categories: economics, human capital, quality of life, environment and governance. This year, HCMC scored 58 (out of 100) for economics, 65.7 for human capital, 64.4 for quality of life, 61.7 for environment and 49.7 for governance. Compared with the 2025 edition, the city improved in three of the five pillars, with governance rising 194 places, human capital 106 places and economics 69 places. It fell 17 places in quality of life and 100 places in environment. In Southeast Asia, HCMC ranked sixth behind Singapore (29th), Kuala Lumpur (65th), Bangkok (122nd), Jakarta (140th) and Manila (174th). It stood ahead of Hanoi, which climbed 45 spots to 243rd globally. Oxford Economics said the index combines current data with forecasts to assess the strengths, weaknesses and development potential of each city. Placing HCMC among "key cities to watch" across Asia Pacific, Oxford Economics said "HCMC's strength is in the Economics category, where it ranks within the top 150 cities." "HCMC's role as Vietnam's export engine and home to the largest port in the country has driven economic growth in the city, and we expect it to rank among the 50 fastest-growing cities over the next five years," it added. "The city is an attractive location for foreign direct investment, which has hit record highs in recent years, encouraging expansion in manufacturing (including higher-value electronic goods) as well as in business service sectors." The ranking comes as HCMC expands its development space and completes its institutional framework for a new phase. On Aug. 24, the National Assembly passed the Urban Development Law which will take effect Oct. 1 with provisions on the process for issuing legal documents under Ho Chi Minh City's new mechanism effective from Sept. 1. The law focuses on decentralization and delegation of powers, giving cities more room to mobilize and allocate resources while strengthening accountability. The National Assembly identified it as one of the institutional foundations for promoting the development of major cities, including HCMC. After its merger with Binh Duong and Vung Tau last year, HCMC is now Vietnam's most populous city with more than 14 million people. It has an economy worth $128 billion and GDP per capita of $9,000. The city aims to rank among the world's top 100 cities by 2030, becoming a modern, dynamic urban center and a regional innovation hub. By 2045, it aims to be among the world's 100 cities with the highest quality of life and become an international megacity in Southeast Asia. Regarding quality of life and environment, the two pillars where the city's ranking declined, it is focusing on improvements over the next five years, including plans to control pollution and manage air quality, implement environmental sanitation projects, relocate houses along canals and upgrade urban areas.
